replica_fidelity: replica with current weighting == production for 12 requests x 3 seeds
notes: Precision/NDCG are 1.0 by construction (candidates are gated by the relevance definitions); they are reported but are not evidence of quality.

mean_ranking_signal_of_served is the classifier probability (label targets) or derived score (angry/stressed) of served tracks: what a larger pool or flatter weighting trades away. It is the ranking's own signal, so it is not an independent quality measure either.
effective_candidate_pool = sum over targets of min(|candidates|, share x pool_multiplier).
